title: Thai-Style Tagine Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired dish made with chicken cooked in a rich tagine sauce, served with steamed jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs
ingredients.amount: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of melted butter in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the minced jawshan and cook until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the chopped syrian, 1 cup of water, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
